levels.surface: مطرف بن عبد الله بن الشخير

notes: «- واللفظ لأبي غسان وابن المثنى -» is an editor's gloss: left out
«حدثني أبي» has no name at that place: relation link; the father's name «هشام» stands earlier in «معاذ بن هشام» and is not merged
The Prophet's words in the sermon are the end of the chain, not a link
